name: lobby-recover
description: Get back to the lobby without touching the bottom nav, and report what actually rendered

steps.expression: (() => { const q = s => !!document.querySelector(s); return JSON.stringify({ inMatch: q('.bnav-play') ? false : true, bell: q('[data-testid=notif-bell]'), missions: q('[data-testid=missions]'), ftue: q('.lobby2-ftue'), bodyStart: document.body.innerText.trim().slice(0,120).replace(/\s+/g,' ') }); })()
steps.name: where are we
